caption: Settings of the two training stages. Head repair fits the classification head alone on the features of the frozen detector, and fine-tuning trains every weight on the teacher set of one round.
note: Two columns, one per training stage, mirroring the paper's table. A dash in the paper means the setting does not apply to that stage and is written as null here. Every fine-tuning value except the epoch count and the decay epoch is a CryoTransformer default; the 50 epochs and the decay at epoch 24 follow the fine-tuning stage of UPicker. Each of the three loss weights scales one term of the Hungarian set loss, and the no-object weight scales the classification term on the queries labelled no-object; the matching costs use the same coefficients as the loss. This table carries no experimental measurement, so neither the EMPIAR-10345 pixel-size caveat nor the best-of-three-seeds convention applies to it.

provenance.source: supp.tex, tab:supp_hparams; docs/notes/supp.md, heading sec:supp:training; originating defaults in recon-aware-pick cryotransformer/finetune.py and models/detr.py, and the head-repair report cryotransformer_head_repair_stage1.md sections 6 and 8

not_in_paper.note: Settings stated in the prose of Sec. S2 rather than in the table, and diagnostics the notes record but the paper does not print.

operating_point.comment: The operating point of the original CryoTransformer implementation, kept unchanged.

head_repair_detail.head: nn.Linear(256, 1) over the 256-dimensional output of the last decoder layer
head_repair_detail.standardization: features standardized per dimension for training, then folded back into the weights as W' = W / sigma, b' = b - W'.mu, so inference runs the detector unchanged
head_repair_detail.two_class_embedding: index 0 is the particle logit, index 1 (no-object) has weight and bias set to zero
head_repair_detail.deployed_split: no held-out split; the deployed head is fit on all micrographs of the 22 entries
head_repair_detail.diagnostic_split: micrograph-level 80/20 with seed 0, 4,138 train and 1,034 validation micrographs, validation positive rate 0.6005

finetune_detail.restart_from: the repaired base checkpoint, every round
finetune_detail.validation_use: monitors the loss only; each round delivers the weights of its last epoch
finetune_detail.teacher_set_split: 50 micrographs per round, split 40/10 into training and validation
finetune_detail.finetune_mode: head_decoder_encoder_resnet, that is every weight except the first residual stage of the backbone
